panels.description: Colorado constructed wetland shows clearer water exiting a nearly closed inlet gate; dated pilot monitor visible. Reserve upper-right for metric and lower-right for second metric.
Survey tray holds aquatic invertebrates beside monitor showing finite wetland capacity. Reserve two separate caption zones.
Croft appears on wall screen beside treatment schedule; his son is only a pale hand beneath hospital bedding. Reserve upper-left for recorded dialogue.
In Nexus, Sitara watches recording while Roman stands beside her in silence. Keep cave and ice visible; reserve upper area for Croft’s line.

items.speaker: CROFT
items.text: You want to stop the work that made this possible.

items.speaker: CROFT
items.text: You knew it was useful. You knew it was controlled. Why is it wrong only now?
